principle: Autonomy is earned through measured reliability and reduced automatically after material failure.

levels.A1_BOUNDED: reversible bounded mutation on exact registered receiver with deterministic gates
levels.A2_REPEATABLE: repeat proven bounded workflow automatically when current-state and duplicate checks pass
levels.A3_COORDINATED: schedule/dispatch multiple bounded workers inside max-five-lane law with independent evaluation
levels.A4_HIGH_TRUST: broader reversible execution inside Canon; still no one-way-door authority

promotion_rule: Increase one level only after repeated evidence on the same capability shows no P0/P1 truth/authority/regression escape and measurable accepted-value gain.
demotion_rule: Any P0/P1 truth, authority, destructive-value or uncontrolled-duplicate incident demotes the affected capability to A0/A1 until Error-to-Immunity closure is proven.

programme_rehydrate_and_reconciliation.reason: repeatable read/reconcile pattern; writeback still independently checked

factory_bounded_product_work.reason: ACTIVE boot exists but accepted-value economics and no-regression track record remain under proof

source_truth_adapter_transfer.reason: marine path passed while terrestrial Jaguar transfer exposed failure; capability must harden before repetition at scale

product_candidate_promotion.reason: Founder judgement and exact gate chain required

brain_cutover.reason: CNS remains shadow until parity/recovery/operational superiority
